core_obligations: Choose surjective etale presentations varphi : V -> Y and U -> V x_Y X with U, V schemes (proof lines 5925-5927).
Identify the preimage of f^{-1}(E) in U with the preimage of varphi^{-1}(E) under U -> V (proof lines 5928-5929).
Apply the scheme case to U -> V and conclude by the definition of etale local constructibility (proof lines 5929-5933).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a subset E of |Y| which is etale locally constructible in Y, the inverse image f^{-1}(E) is etale locally constructible in X (source lines 5915-5922). The proof chooses surjective etale presentations varphi : V -> Y and U -> V x_Y X, notes that U -> X is surjective etale and that the preimage of f^{-1}(E) in U is the preimage of varphi^{-1}(E) under U -> V, and then applies the scheme case for U -> V together with the definition of etale local constructibility.
